reqBaseAnnouncement.remarks: Appointment of a Director - Mr Sivaraman Karunamoorthy (Independent - Non-Executive Director)

dirList.profile:
Brief Profile on Mr. Sivaraman Karunamoorthy
Mr. Sivaraman Karunamoorthy is an ACCA-qualified senior finance professional with over 15 years’ experience in financial planning and analysis (FP&A), corporate finance, risk management and finance process automation.
He currently serves as Finance Business Partner – FP&A, Corporate Finance & Process Automation at Mindset Health Pty Ltd (Australia), where he leads financial forecasting, multi-scenario budgeting and long-term planning, oversees capital and liquidity management, and directs cross-border statutory and tax compliance. He has played a key role in designing and implementing AI-driven finance automation (including the use of Claude AI) to improve accuracy, speed and control across core financial workflows.
Prior to this, he was Head of Finance at Findmyfare (Private) Limited in Sri Lanka, advising the CEO and Board on financial performance and strategy, capital structure and funding options, and the design of internal controls and risk mitigation frameworks. In this role he managed treasury, banking relationships and working capital and ensured compliance with SLFRS/IFRS and statutory audit requirements. He previously progressed through finance roles at Findmyfare and served as accountant at Knightsbridge Ecommerce (Private) Limited, gaining hands-on experience in SLFRS-compliant financial reporting, tax, budgeting and audit coordination.
Mr. Karunamoorthy is a member of the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA, UK). His core strengths include strategic FP&A, corporate finance and capital structuring, financial governance and risk management, cash flow optimisation and executive/board-level decision support, with a particular focus on leveraging automation and AI tools to enhance financial operations and reporting.
